issues.problem: Mutating HTTP requests without gameplay-session sequencing bypass receipt replay.
issues.impact: Two identical requestIds deployed 10 troops twice, bank100→80 and two army identities. It spends twice; no free troops demonstrated.
issues.minimum_fix: Require supported durable logical identity for every public mutation, or reject incomplete identity before execution. Reuse current lease/sequence receipt authority. Keep read-only compatibility. Test every exposed mutation, lost response, restart and stale writer.

issues.problem: Legal deployment can make the required tutorial attack impossible.
issues.impact: Bank500 at FIRST_ATTACK_AVAILABLE can all be deployed; tutorial then requires a bank commit, rejects deployed-army attack and another normal workout, and cannot restart a nondefeated world.
issues.minimum_fix: Allow the existing authoritative deployed-army attack path to satisfy tutorial progression and preserve scripted ordering. Do not forbid approved deployment, grant troops, erase the tutorial or add balance changes. Add HTTP journey for partial/all deployment and reload.

issues.problem: No production catalog bootstrap; tutorial is bound to legacy selected workout; selection can advertise a workout that normal start rejects.
issues.impact: Fresh players cannot start the promised normal-workout loop. Supplying ratio data alone does not remove the tutorial binding.
issues.minimum_fix: Load and validate an explicit approved catalog in production composition; bind tutorial to authoritative authored workout selection; return truthful availability/configuration errors. Test with clearly labeled fixtures until approved content arrives. Preserve lock/settlement mechanics.
issues.product_decision: NO new economics; approved content IDs are authoring inputs

issues.problem: Fresh authored worlds have population0 but all natural territory event candidates require population≥2000.
issues.impact: Food/Stability cannot drive normal world events;100 registered-Level2 event turns triggered0. This is a deterministic eligibility mismatch, not evidence for changing random probabilities.
issues.minimum_fix: Resolve whether population is authored/initialized for events or the eligibility contract must use existing non-population facts. Then integrate/test natural eligible events without inventing a population economy or silent balance values.

issues.problem: Hydration overwrites event-mutated territory resourceOutput with immutable authored output.
issues.impact: Seed11 event-eligible Level2 fixture: t_07 Gold output1→2 via Resource Discovery→1 after reload; all invariants pass. Persistent outcomes depend on reload.
issues.minimum_fix: Separate immutable base from canonical runtime consequence or preserve its effective value under an explicit compatibility migration. Add actual event→production→save/reload→continued-production equivalence tests. Preserve authored fingerprint/geography checks.
issues.product_decision: NO for loss prevention; migration/representation needs engineering review

issues.problem: Choice reducer has no public command/inbox; some advertised consequence fields are explicitly not applied.
issues.impact: Player cannot durably inspect and answer an available choice through the production API; some choice narratives promise unsupported effects.
issues.minimum_fix: Expose owned active-event choices and one receipted choice handler using existing reducer; preserve expiry/reload and private data boundary. Map only approved implemented effects or remove unsupported promises. Do not add garrison morale/infrastructure meters.
issues.product_decision: YES only for unsupported consequence replacements/default policy not already defined

issues.problem: Valid unowned territories cannot be captured through exposed ATTACK/MOVE.
issues.impact: Full occupation of worlds containing neutral land cannot be completed; existing registered worlds are all faction-owned, so this is not their immediate blocker.
issues.minimum_fix: Define minimal neutral occupation/resistance rule, then implement via existing command/physical arrival/ownership transaction. Retain eight proactive actions; no legacy EXPAND resurrection.

issues.problem: Ordinary MOVE allows entry into foreign-owned territory without attack intent or encounter.
issues.impact: Actual Level2 MOVE+ADVANCE_WORLD reaches t_07 after2ticks; owner unchanged, no invasion. Hostile transit and attacks are inconsistent unless this passage is intentionally legal.
issues.minimum_fix: Document permitted WAR/PEACE/neutral passage and enforce the approved rule at start and arrival, reusing attack/invasion and movement authority. Do not automatically declare war or invent border tolls.
issues.product_decision: YES: foreign passage versus hostile entry semantics

issues.problem: Invasion response, protection and recovery use player-facing simulation ticks, not independently stored real-world deadlines.
issues.impact: 30 world minutes become≈300 real minutes wholly offline; pause can freeze/extend gates. Cannot claim all real-world timing doctrine is implemented.
issues.minimum_fix: Approve an explicit gate-by-gate clock-domain/pause table, implement only real-world gates with trusted receipt/deadline identity, migrate active obligations conservatively, test live/offline/catch-up equivalence. Do not globally speed world ticks.
issues.product_decision: YES: classify response/protection/recovery/max workout gates and empire-pause behavior

issues.problem: GET_COMMAND_INDEX includes internal command metadata while HTTP uses an explicit allowlist.
issues.impact: Client discovery can advertise calls that will always be rejected; the allowlist still protects execution.
issues.minimum_fix: Label public capability explicitly or project a filtered public index without changing internal registration.

issues.problem: Long-lived operations, receipts and audit history need a measured retention strategy if capacity requires it.
issues.impact: Larger snapshots make cloning/hydration costly; arbitrary pruning could lose idempotency or reward authority.
issues.minimum_fix: Profile first under AUD-016. Design lossless/safe retention only when justified, retaining stable identities and durable settlement facts. Do not treat compaction as permission to discard history.
issues.product_decision: NO gameplay decision; retention policy may need approval
